authority: With the grouping-separator set to "'", the "," in the picture is an ordinary passive character, and F&O 4.7.3 says "A sub-picture must not contain a passive character that is preceded by an active character and that is followed by another active character". F&O raises the single code FODF1310 for every picture-string violation; JSONata splits it into D3080-D3093, one per rule. The JSONata documentation publishes no error-code page, so what this case pins is the classification — which F&O rule the picture breaks — and the code is how jsntrs names it.
